text: When you're gearing up for a ride on your trusty bike, choose a gear that’s comfortable for the distance you're planning to cover and the terrain you’ll be riding on. A lower gear bike means a higher gear ratio and will demand more effort but can be ideal for steep hills or longer distances. Always wear a quality helmet to protect your head and brain. This simple yet critical piece of safety equipment is essential, regardless of the skill level or experience of the rider. And remember, safety should be your top priority throughout your ride. Ride cautiously, obeying all traffic laws and road signs, and always be aware of your surroundings. Avoid distractions and keep your eyes on the road or handlebars to ensure a safe and enjoyable cycling experience.
summary: Choose a gear bike, wear a helmet, and ride safely.
